summary: Solid core logic (TSV intermediate format, modular parsers, good error handling) but critical blockers prevent shipping: (1) jq is not installed in the aggregate job—the script requires it (line 33 of aggregate-test-results.sh) but workflow never installs it, causing failure; (2) requirement mandates shellcheck/bash -n validation—workflow omits these checks; (3) AGGREGATION_OK=true (aggregate job, line 42) is printed but never exported or used; (4) run-act-tests.sh hardcodes ACT_IMAGE to nonexistent act-ubuntu-pwsh:latest without fallback; (5) workflow references test/ and fixture directories not shown. Awk parsers are elegant but complex (maintainability risk). If jq and test files existed, would score 3–4.
